map.：尸斑区切开后血液流出（生前血不凝固）；无尸斑区切开无血液流出: : blood flows out when the lividity area is cut (antemortem blood does not coagulate); no blood flows from an area without lividity
map.：窒息死者尸斑出现早、颜色深、分布广（点状出血多见）: : in asphyxial death lividity appears early, is dark and widely distributed (punctate haemorrhages are common)
map.：高温加速尸斑形成和扩散；低温延缓尸斑发展: : high temperature accelerates formation and spread, low temperature delays development
map.：窒息死尸斑出现早且显著；失血死尸斑浅淡或不明显；急死尸斑明显: : lividity appears early and marked in asphyxial death, pale or invisible in haemorrhagic death, obvious in sudden death
map.：受压部位无尸斑（如仰卧位背部受压区）: : no lividity in pressure areas (such as the compressed back of a supine body)

map.按尸斑分期：坠积期（<8 h）按压褪色、指压白痕可复红；扩散期（8~12 h）按: Phases of livor mortis: congestion phase (under 8 h) blanches on pressure and the finger-pressure white mark can turn red again; diffusion phase (8 to 12 h) blanches only partly on pressure and does not easily turn red again; fixation phase (over 12 h) does not blanch and no longer shifts when the position changes.
map.尸斑位于背侧、指压明显褪色且白痕数秒复红 → 坠积期（死后<8 h）；若按压仅部: Lividity on the dorsal side that blanches clearly on pressure with the white mark turning red within seconds indicates the congestion phase (under 8 h after death). Blanching only partly on pressure with partial shift of lividity when the position changes indicates the diffusion phase (8 to 12 h); no blanching indicates the fixation phase (over 12 h).
map.尸斑固定时间受什么影响？: What affects the time of fixation?
map.受温度、贫血、休克、中毒（如氰化物樱桃红）、受压与否影响；贫血者尸斑淡、固定慢，: Temperature, anaemia, shock, poisoning (such as cherry red from cyanide) and pressure all matter. Lividity is pale and fixes slowly in anaemic people, so other indicators are needed.
map.尸斑能判断原始体位吗？: Can lividity reveal the original body position?
map.能。尸斑出现于低下未受压部位，据此可反推死后原始体位，若与现体位不符提示移尸。: Yes. Lividity appears in low, unpressure-dependent areas, so the original post-mortem position can be back-inferred; a mismatch with the current position indicates the body was moved.
